reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified. Spec (01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json lines 677-694) requires: 'Blobs from local EL that skip KZG verification must still produce valid data columns.' Code deviates: Fulu path (message_router.nim:155-193) broadcasts data columns WITHOUT blob validation, while Deneb/Electra path (L115-131) validates blobs before broadcasting. beacon_validators.nim:587-589 calls assemble_data_column_sidecars on raw EL blobs, which invokes computeCells (peerdas_helpers.nim:325) without prior KZG validation. Invalid blobs from compromised/buggy local EL will produce invalid data columns that corrupt DAS network availability. Severity calibrated to Medium: requires compromised local EL (semi-trusted boundary per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE trust_assumptions.engine_api), affecting single validator's data columns rather than network-wide impact. Bug bounty scope marks engine_api trust violations as 'conditional' severity.
